name: Cable Station Reef (Cables Reef)

confidence.reason: Footprint position, orientation and scale are confirmed by an as-built-era survey with coordinates (DoT WA soundings, Nov 1999: 91.0 % of rock soundings inside the outline, free scale fit 0.979) and by four georeferenced Esri images on which the rock patch coincides with the outline. Dimensions 121 x 76 m differ from the text 140 x 70 m by -13 % / +9 %; the survey and the printed dimensions agree with each other, the text is rounded. The south-arm extension is NOT confirmed (low confidence, separate version).

outline_versions.name: Design plan + drawn southern-arm extension (not confirmed by soundings or imagery)
outline_versions.method: Silhouette trace of the outer foot ('interface line') on Blacka et al. (2013) Fig A.2 (Lyons 1992 design plan), scaled from its printed dimensions (6.51 px/m); plus the 'additional fill area' triangle of img06 (320 m3) registered on corners P2 and P1.
outline_versions.level: outer foot of the designed rock mound (interface line between new rock and the existing seabed), with the extension triangle added at the south-arm end
outline_versions.note: Default: the design drawing of the built reef plus the extension the dossier says was added at the southern end. Not a survey: the built extent is unknown (no aerial or survey image found yet). Extension size is read from a low-resolution drawing. NOT CONFIRMED (2026-10-10): Feb 2002 soundings in the triangle show 0.43 m of rock (n=23) against 1.29 m inside the original plan and 0.19 m in the 25 m ring outside; the triangle is not darker than its surroundings on Esri imagery.

outline_versions.name: Design plan footprint (Lyons 1992 / Blacka 2013 Fig A.2), georeferenced and confirmed by DoT soundings (default)
outline_versions.method: Same silhouette trace as the default, without the extension triangle.
outline_versions.level: outer foot of the designed rock mound (interface line)
outline_versions.note: canonical.polygons_m is this polygon. Footprint 4,049 m2; the ramp (area between the set-out line and the crest line) is 3,113 m2. Georeferenced and confirmed 2026-10-10: 91.0 % of the Nov 1999 rock soundings lie inside, scale within 2 %; the dark rock patch on four Esri images coincides with it.

versions_info: The default outline is the original construction design plan (outer foot of the rock mound, traced on Blacka et al. 2013 Fig A.2 after Lyons 1992, scaled from its printed dimensions), georeferenced by fitting it to the DoT WA soundings of Nov 1999 (91 % of the rock soundings inside, scale within 2 %) and checked on Esri satellite images (the dark rock patch coincides with it). The drawn southern-arm extension (320 m3) is kept as a separate version because neither the 2002 soundings nor the imagery confirm it. The V printed on the paper's site plan (Fig 7) and an early concept sketch are shown for comparison.

design_surface.note: Design ramp of the Lyons plan: RL contours -1.0 (crest line, inner V) to -3.0 (set-out line, outer edge) every 0.5 m; slopes 1:20 at the apex, 1:15 right arm, ~1:13 left arm (printed labels). Datum of RL not stated on the drawing (see 3d/ and HANDOFF).

geo.polygons_note: default outline = original design plan; GDA94 coordinates treated as WGS84 (about 1.8 m difference)
